findings.claim: The test named AllGeneratedTypesAreExcludedFromCodeCoverage only checks that each generated file contains at least one attribute, so it does not verify its stated per-type guarantee: resolver files contain several generated classes, and one could lose its attribute without either new test failing.

receipt_plan.detail: Remove the ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute from only FormatterCache<T> in ResolverTemplate.tt while leaving the resolver class and GetFormatterHelper attributes intact. Regenerate ResolverTemplate.cs and run CodeCoverageExclusionTests; both tests still pass, demonstrating that the per-type regression is not detected.
